rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for compiling material gathered from different sources.

example.english: I’ll compile all the interview materials for you.
example.traditional: 我幫你整理晒啲訪問資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 zing2 lei5 saai3 di1 fong2 man6 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this formal term especially for compiling a dictionary, reference work, or other substantial publication.

example.english: Experts worked together to compile this dictionary.
example.traditional: 專家合力編纂呢部辭典。
example.jyutping: zyun1 gaa1 hap6 lik6 pin1 zyun2 ni1 bou6 ci4 din2

rows.note: Use this specifically when a compiler processes source code into executable code.

example.english: This piece of code needs to compile before it can run.
example.traditional: 呢段程式碼要編譯咗先可以運行。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 cing4 sik1 maa5 jiu3 pin1 jik6 zo2 sin1 ho2 ji5 wan6 hang4
